# VSCode Links Docs

_The docs for VSC Links, a VSCode extension that lets you create links in source code wherever and to whatever you want. 📖_

</div>

&nbsp;

## Why does this exist?
VSC Links needed docs.

## Where to find it

Published at [vsc-links.webry.com](https://vsc-links.webry.com/).

## How to run it

A [VitePress](https://vitepress.dev) site.
1. `npm install`
2. `npm run dev`
3. `npm run build`
4. `npm run preview`
